The Story

From the paratroopers to AI agents.

Brazil, Israel, a combat unit, a youth program, a sales role, and now a company of my own. The thread: find a messy real-world process, then build the system that makes it run itself.

  • 01

    Pressure first

    Lebanon, Gaza, West Bank with Battalion 202. Calm and teamwork when it counts.

  • 02

    Sell it, then build it

    10 to 40 stores at CYCPLUS: I know what customers actually pay for.

  • 03

    Automate the boring part

    Agents that cut days of manual work to hours, with source-cited outputs.

  • 04

    Ship it live

    Supabase, GitHub, Vercel and per-user logins, not just prototypes.
